title: A message about the puppet show
passage: Hi, Jo. For Saturday’s puppet show, bring the cloth bag if it has a drawstring. Leave the ticket jar at the gate. The costume case shuts, but there’s a gap under its lid. Use the nearer fountain benches if the view works. I tried them today: the tubs hide the bottom step. Even the cushions only get you a view of the middle step. For the newsletter, Mina let us print her bowing photo, not the rehearsal one. She said, “Just don’t use it to sell seats.” Our recap and next-show notice are going on the same page. The first scene happens on the bottom step. The bakery seats are between the shop and the stage, with a clear view toward the stage. They have no backrest. Today the loose costume bells fell out; the costumes themselves were fine. The editor sometimes makes a recap photo clickable. This week that link would open the ticket page, not the story. We can leave the photo unlinked.
passageZh: 嗨，喬。星期六的布偶戲，如果布袋有束口繩就帶來吧。票券罐留在入口。戲服箱蓋得上，但蓋子底下有道縫。 如果看得到舞台，就用比較近的噴水池長椅。我今天試坐了：花盆會擋住最低一階。即使用座墊坐高一點，也只能看到中間那一階。 說到社區通訊，米娜同意我們刊登她那張鞠躬照，但不包括排練照。她說：「只是別用它賣票。」我們會把回顧和下一場的公告放在同一頁。 開場那一幕在最低一階演出。麵包店旁的座位在店面與舞台之間，朝舞台看沒有遮擋。座位沒有椅背。今天散放的戲服鈴鐺掉了出來，不過戲服本身沒事。 編輯有時會讓回顧照片可以點擊。本週點了照片會開啟售票頁面，不是回顧文章。我們也可以不幫照片加連結。
